questions.stem: The right to practice a religion would be found in what internationally recognised document?

options.B: The Charter of the United Nations
options.D: The International Covenant on Economic, Social and Cultural Rights

questions.answerNote: School key gives D (ICESCR), but the right to practise religion is in ICCPR Art 18, not in any listed option, so the question is arguably defective; ICESCR does not protect religion.
